history.hypothesis: progression for wiz-hum-cha-mal is gated on experience, not depth -- `current_strategy` refuses to leave the first dungeon level until `blstats.experience_level >= 8`, and every seed either crosses that gate early (progress 0.074-0.117, dlvl 2-7) or dies on dlvl 1 below it (progress 0.02-0.07). The explorer searches five squares deep on every newly visited tile, and that single call is where the run goes: 2255 search calls ate 9018 of 18578 turns (48%) on seed 0, 9778 of 17693 (55%) on seed 1 and 6983 of 18485 (38%) on seed 5, against ~55 turns per monster kill.  Three searches keep the discovery rate (a secret door or a hidden trap is found on the first or second search of a square; the fourth and fifth almost never pay) while handing ~1800 turns per run back to the only thing the xp gate rewards, killing monsters.  Measured over 20 local seeds x three budgets: 0.0597 -> 0.0756, 0.0524 -> 0.0505 and 0.0592 -> 0.0664 mean BALROG progression, with seeds reaching experience level 8 going from 10/20 to 15/20.

history.report:
Iteration complete. Summary of this turn:

**Tested and rejected:** lowering the descent gate (`global_logic.py:518`, XP≥8→4/6/2). Measured negative — it lets strong seeds (2, 11) descend early and die, net −0.008/seed. Reverted to `>= 8`.

**Implemented and kept:** wizard force-bolt spellcasting (was entirely unwired — `known_spells` never populated).
- `character.py`: `parse_spellcast_view` now parses WIZARD menus (skips `(end)`, stores category).
- `agent.py`: enabled the parse in `main()`; fixed a latent `cast()` bug where diagonal directions were yielded as `'ne'` (rejected by `step()`); added the `cast` action handler.
- `fight_heur.py`: `get_potential_spellcast_usages` casts a known attack spell at a monster within 3 tiles, skipping pets, stationary molds, hungry states, and confusion/stun.

**Result:** wiring works (up to 126 casts/game). First version stalled casting until starvation (seed 0 Xp6→Xp1, seed 4 Xp10→Xp3); hunger guard + range≤3 fixed that. Measured 15 seeds in-harness and 10 with the real arena (they agree seed-for-seed): big wins on weak seeds (3, 6, 10, 12, 13) offset by losses on strong seeds (2, 7, 9, 11, 14), **net ≈ −0.003 mean (neutral, within noise)**.

**Open lead:** `prop.confusion/hallu/stun` never return True even when casts fail with "Your knowledge of this spell is twisted", so ~20–40% of casts fail and burn turns; a reliable confusion check should make this clearly positive.

Logged to `experience.md`.
